name: cytokine receptor like factor 2

function.text: CRLF2 encodes cytokine receptor-like factor 2. Annotated molecular activities include coreceptor activity and cytokine receptor activity. It participates in cytokine-mediated signaling pathway and positive regulation of interleukin-5 production.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
